pro_course_detail.title: Confidence in Public Speaking, Interviews, and Presentations
pro_course_detail.description: Let's be honest: speaking in front of people in your native language can be nerve-wracking in itself, let alone doing it in a foreign language! But do not lose hope: there are countless ways to prepare yourself and gain confidence so you can ace your next interview, presentation, or debate. In this course, we will focus on two essential concepts: 1) organization and 2) delivery. Organizing will help you develop your plan of action, what to say, how to respond, and what materials you will need. The second focus of delivery covers simply the best way to effectively leave a positive impression on an audience or interviewer and to develop people skills and confidence. The combination of these will carry you to success. Included are mock interviews, practicing presentations, and debates.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation and Coaching 💪💪💪
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed for students who are looking to interview with an English-speaking company.  You will be prepared to answer all types of interview questions after this session.

This is a great chance to do a practice interview with a native English speaker with management and hiring experience and get feedback before you interview with a company.

I'll start by reviewing your CV and the job description of the company you are applying for.
Then, I will ask you a few questions about the company and the specific role you are applying for.  Then we'll discuss potential interview questions based on your industry and role.  I'll work with you to ensure you have strong answers as well as examples from your past experience to help you answer the most common interview questions.  

I'll make sure that you're comfortable explaining your answers in English and that you are delivering them in a clear and concise manner.

I'll also coach you on proper interviewing etiquette, including before, during and after the interview. My goal is to make sure you feel comfortable and confident before your interview.  

I was a hiring manager for three years and have interviewed hundreds of potential candidates in the past, so I know what types of questions companies and hiring managers like to ask and how to best answer these questions.

We can also discuss salary negotiations and job expectations.

You will feel more confident and prepared for your interview after this session.

Do you have an interview in the next few days or even the next few hours?  This class will help you get ready for your interview in as little as one hour.
